items.title: Citigroup (C) Sets Post GFC Record With $817 Million Multifamily CMBS Deal
items.summary: Citigroup priced an $817 million multifamily only CMBS conduit, the largest of its kind for the bank since the global financial crisis. The deal is backed exclusively by multifamily loans and points to active institutional appetite for higher leverage apartment debt. This transaction highlights Citi's role as a key lender in US commercial real estate securitization.
